title: Uruguayan Galangal Grilled Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic Uruguayan-inspired dish featuring grilled chicken and galangal, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Mince the galangal and add to the bowl with the chicken.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken and galangal, and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Thread the chicken and galangal onto skewers.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
